options.name: authmode
options.description: Authentication clients.  Required if mode == client_tls_user.

options.name: ca
options.description: Certificate Authority name.

options.name: cert
options.description: Client certificate name.

options.name: cert_depth
options.description: Depth of certificates to check.

options.name: client2client
options.description: Allow communication between clients connected to this client.

options.name: compression
options.description: Allowed compression to be used with this VPN instance.

options.name: compression_push
options.description: Push the selected Compression setting to connecting clients.

options.name: create_gw
options.description: Which gateway types to create.

options.name: crl
options.description: Certificate Revocation List name.

options.name: custom_options
options.description: Custom openvpn options.

options.name: data_ciphers
options.description: Allowed cryptographic algorithms.

options.name: data_ciphers_fallback
options.description: Fallback cryptographic algorithm.

options.name: dev_mode
options.description: Device mode.

options.name: dh_length
options.description: DH parameter length.

options.name: digest
options.description: Auth digest algorithm. The list of valid digest algorithms is determined from the output of C(openvpn --show-digests), but curently includes: BLAKE2b512, BLAKE2s256, KECCAK-KMAC-128, KECCAK-KMAC-256, MD5, MD5-SHA1, NULL, RIPEMD160, SHA1, SHA224, SHA256, SHA3-224, SHA3-256, SHA3-384, SHA3-512, SHA384, SHA512, SHA512-224, SHA512-256, SHAKE128, SHAKE256

options.name: disable
options.description: Is the OpenVPN config disabled.

options.name: dns_client1
options.description: DNS client 1.

options.name: dns_client2
options.description: DNS client 2.

options.name: dns_client3
options.description: DNS client 3.

options.name: dns_client4
options.description: DNS client 4.

options.name: dns_domain
options.description: DNS default domain.

options.name: dynamic_ip
options.description: Allow connected clients to retain their connections if their IP address changes.

options.name: ecdh_curve
options.description: Elliptic Curve to use for key exchange.

options.name: gwredir
options.description: Redirect IPv4 gateway.

options.name: gwredir6
options.description: Redirect IPv6 gateway.

options.name: interface
options.description: The interface for OpenVPN to listen on.

options.name: maxclients
options.description: The maximum number of clients allowed to concurrently connect to this client.

options.name: mode
options.description: The client mode.

options.name: name
options.description: The name of the OpenVPN configuration.

options.name: ncp_enable
options.description: Enable data encryption negotiation.

options.name: passtos
options.description: Set the TOS IP header value of tunnel packets to match the encapsulated packet value.

options.name: protocol
options.description: The protocol.

options.name: push_register_dns
options.description: Push DNS to client.

options.name: remote_network
options.description: IPv4 networks that will be routed through the tunnel.

options.name: remote_networkv6
options.description: IPv6 networks that will be routed through the tunnel.

options.name: server_addr
options.description: The address for OpenVPN to connect to.

options.name: server_port
options.description: The port for OpenVPN to connect to.

options.name: shared_key
options.description: Pre-shared key for shared key modes.  If set to 'generate' it will create a key if one does not already exist.

options.name: state
options.description: State in which to leave the OpenVPN config.

options.name: strictusercn
options.description: Enforce a match between the common name of the client certificate and the username given at login.

options.name: tls
options.description: TLS Key.  If set to 'generate' it will create a key if one does not already exist.  Not valid with p2p_shared_key mode.

options.name: tls_type
options.description: Use TLS for authentication ('auth') or encyprtion and authentication ('crypt').  Only used when tls is set.

options.name: topology
options.description: The method used to supply a virtual adapter IP address to clients when using TUN mode on IPv4.

options.name: tunnel_network
options.description: IPv4 virtual network used for private communications between this client and client hosts expressed using CIDR notation.

options.name: tunnel_networkv6
options.description: IPv6 virtual network used for private communications between this client and client hosts expressed using CIDR notation.

options.name: verbosity_level
options.description: Verbosity level.
